name: Hometown Drive-In (Paris / Montpelier, ID) Classic Smashed Cheeseburger & Fries
whyItWorks: Historic Bear Lake valley roadside burger. Fresh griddled beef patty with melted cheese on a soft bun. Easily digested roadside comfort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold onions and pickles).
